2609.27373.title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models
2609.27373.paper_summary: Recurrent language models repeatedly apply shared network blocks to refine latent representations, but standard inference recomputes global attention at every recurrent step. We study attention dynamics across recurrent depth and find that attention support and distributions stabilize substantially earlier than hidden states and attention outputs. This suggests a two-stage structure: early steps discover a sparse working set of relevant context, while later steps refine representations over largely the same routing support. Motivated by this structure, we introduce WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation), a training-free method that uses unrestricted global attention during early recurrence and later reuses directly discovered block-structured support while keeping recurrent depth and within-support attention computation dynamic. Controlled interventions show that recurrent discovery is important and that support-only reuse better preserves model behavior than more restrictive attention-reuse alternatives. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, WISE largely preserves full-attention performance, while context scaling reveals increasingly sparse working sets and greater efficiency gains. Quality is largely preserved through 2K context, with a measurable loss at 4K. An optimized sparse-attention implementation achieves up to a 1.76x attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K and a 1.36x speedup for the full 32-step attention trajectory. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code.
2609.27373.paper_summary_zh: 重複語言模型重複應用共享網絡區塊來細化潛在表示，但標準推理在每個重複步驟中都會重新計算全局注意力。我們研究了重複深度中的注意力動態，發現注意力支持和分佈在隱藏狀態和注意力輸出之前就已經顯著穩定。這表明了一種兩階段結構：早期步驟發現了一組稀疏的相關上下文工作集，而後期步驟則在基本相同的路由支持上細化表示。受到這一結構的啟發，我們引入了WISE（工作集推理與支持利用），這是一種無需訓練的方法，在早期重複期間使用不受限制的全局注意力，並在後期重用直接發現的區塊結構支持，同時保持重複深度和支持內部注意力計算的動態性。控制干預顯示，重複發現是重要的，僅支持重用比更具限制性的注意力重用替代方案更好地保留了模型行為。在多跳問答基準測試中，WISE在很大程度上保留了全注意力性能，而上下文擴展顯示出越來越稀疏的工作集和更大的效率增益。在2K上下文中質量基本保持不變，而在4K時則有可測量的損失。一個優化的稀疏注意力實現達到了在4K上比原生FlashAttention快1.76倍的注意力加速，以及在完整32步注意力軌跡上快1.36倍的加速。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code 獲得。
